title: Potassium balance, compartments and membrane physiology
guide: The 40 mg per mmol conversion, 50 mEq per kilogram of total body potassium, the ICF and ECF component table, the organ distribution with its 3000 mmol total, and the paired electrophysiology arrows for hypo- and hyperkalemia.

title: The pump, daily regulation and tubular handling
sec: Na+/K+ ATPase and renal excretion · p969
guide: Shared digoxin and potassium binding, potassium in digoxin toxicity, athlete adaptations, the 100 mEq intake split, the 700 mEq filtered load with its PCT, TALH and collecting-duct handling, and the severity rules for significant hypo- and hyperkalemia.

title: Aldosterone in the collecting duct and diuretic effects on potassium
guide: Beta or principal cell as the site of action, the numbered ENaC, ROMK, pump and alpha-intercalated cell structures, AIP and vasopressin, the Conn triad, and the printed electropositivity chain that explains thiazide hypokalemia.

title: Causes of hypokalemia and cellular potassium shifts
guide: The non-renal and renal tree with its acid-base and blood pressure forks, the shift boxes with insulin, catecholamines and pH, magnesium and ROMK, the clinical list, and the deficit curve.

title: ECG changes, investigations and the diagnostic algorithm
guide: The four-step ECG ladder with U waves and QT, the torsades strip, the three investigations with their urine potassium thresholds, and the algorithm that runs from urine potassium through acid-base status to blood pressure and urine chloride.

title: Replacing potassium and entering hyperkalemia
guide: The acute KCl infusion rules, maintenance dosing with citrate syrup and Shohl's solution, the tablet limitation, and the three-column hyperkalemia cause tree with its spurious entries.

title: RTA type IV, the transtubular gradient and clinical features
guide: The definition of type IV RTA, the hypo- and hyperreninemic true hypoaldosteronism lists, the pseudohypoaldosteronism genetic, CTID and drug entries, the TTKG formula with its fludrocortisone step, and the four-system clinical list.

title: Hyperkalemic ECG progression and emergency treatment
guide: The five-row potassium-to-ECG table, calcium gluconate as drug of choice with its dose and brief cover, insulin with dextrose, high-dose nebulized albuterol, the obsolete binders and dialysis as definitive therapy.
